description: This file implements the HdmiCec plugin class for managing HDMI CEC communication, including device management, message processing, and interaction with system components via IARM. It contains class methods, event handlers, and thread routines for CEC device polling and message handling.

classes.name: HdmiCec
classes.description: Main plugin class managing HDMI CEC communication, device list, message processing, and system event handling.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes different CEC message types such as ActiveSource, ImageViewOn, TextViewOn, etc., updating device list accordingly.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up IARM connections.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, disables CEC, and deinitializes IARM.

methods.name: getActiveSourceStatus
methods.description: Returns whether the device is the active source.

methods.name: InitializeIARM
methods.description: Sets up IARM event handlers for CEC and HDMI hotplug events.

methods.name: DeinitializeIARM
methods.description: Removes IARM event handlers.

methods.name: cecMgrEventHandler
methods.description: Handles CEC manager events such as daemon initialization and status updates.

methods.name: dsHdmiEventHandler
methods.description: Handles HDMI hotplug events.

methods.name: onCECDaemonInit
methods.description: Handles CEC daemon initialization, toggling CEC enable state.

methods.name: cecStatusUpdated
methods.description: Updates internal state based on CEC status changes, including logical address and device type.

methods.name: onHdmiHotPlug
methods.description: Handles HDMI hotplug connect events, updating physical and logical addresses.

methods.name: setEnabledWrapper
methods.description: API wrapper to enable or disable CEC.

methods.name: getEnabledWrapper
methods.description: API wrapper to get CEC enable status.

methods.name: getCECAddressesWrapper
methods.description: API wrapper to retrieve CEC addresses.

methods.name: sendMessageWrapper
methods.description: API wrapper to send a CEC message.

methods.name: loadSettings
methods.description: Loads CEC enable/disable setting from persistent storage.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables CEC, managing threads and system state accordingly.

methods.name: CECEnable
methods.description: Enables CEC, initializes connections, threads, and libcec.

methods.name: CECDisable
methods.description: Disables CEC, cleans up connections, threads, and libcec.

methods.name: getPhysicalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the physical address via libcec.

methods.name: getLogicalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the logical address via libcec.

methods.name: getEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether CEC is enabled.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns device name (stubbed as 'STB').

methods.name: getCECAddresses
methods.description: Returns current CEC physical and logical addresses.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a base64-encoded CEC message.

methods.name: sendActiveSourceEvent
methods.description: Notifies system of active source status change.

methods.name: cecAddressesChanged
methods.description: Notifies address change events.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Handles incoming CEC frames, updates active source status, and notifies system.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Sends message notification to system.

methods.name: getDeviceList
methods.description: Returns list of connected CEC devices.

methods.name: pingDeviceUpdateList
methods.description: Pings a device to check connectivity, updates device list accordingly.

methods.name: addDevice
methods.description: Adds a device to the device list and notifies system.

methods.name: removeAllCecDevices
methods.description: Removes all devices from the list.

methods.name: removeDevice
methods.description: Removes a specific device from the list.

methods.name: sendUnencryptMsg
methods.description: Sends an unencrypted raw message.

methods.name: requestVendorID
methods.description: Requests vendor ID from a device.

methods.name: requestOsdName
methods.description: Requests OSD name from a device.

methods.name: requestCecDevDetails
methods.description: Requests device details (vendor ID and OSD name).

methods.name: threadRun
methods.description: Polling thread for device detection.

methods.name: threadUpdateCheck
methods.description: Thread for updating device info periodically.
